name: marketing-funnel
description: Whole-funnel revenue/profit lever prioritizer for DTC ecommerce. Pulls live metrics (Databox, GA4, Klaviyo, Meta), scores every funnel lever by Headroom x Sensitivity, and returns the biggest lever for long-run revenue and profit with graph-verified causal chains and grounded plays. Includes an embedded live correlation graph with period-over-period node tracking, per-node noise floors, and weekly trend history. A verification gate blocks any ungrounded number, dollar, or claim.
